BATA, CAMISON, PIJAMA, NINGUNA

Retorna únicamente el tipo de prenda, sin comentarios adicionales.

parameters.query:
WITH upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO variables_wonder_store (phone_number, variable_name, value)
  VALUES 
    ('{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.phone_number }}', 'most_similar_item', ''),
    ('{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.phone_number }}', 'greatest_value', '0'),
    ('{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.phone_number }}', 'row_id', '0'),
    ('{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.phone_number }}', 'item_color', '')
  ON CONFLICT (phone_number, variable_name)
  DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value
  RETURNING variable_name, value
)
SELECT string_agg(variable_name || '=' || value, ', ') AS combined_result
FROM upserted;

SELECT json_object_agg(variable_name, value) AS variables
FROM variables_wonder_store
WHERE phone_number = '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.phone_number }}'
  AND variable_name IN ('most_similar_item', 'greatest_value', 'row_id', 'item_color');

UPDATE variables_wonder_store
SET value = CASE variable_name
    WHEN 'most_similar_item' THEN ''
    WHEN 'greatest_value' THEN '0'
    WHEN 'row_id' THEN ''
    WHEN 'item_color' THEN ''
    ELSE value
END
WHERE phone_number = '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.phone_number }}'
  AND variable_name IN ('most_similar_item', 'greatest_value', 'row_id', 'item_color');
